## Daily Gift 1.0.2

- removed references for browsing context

- Initial public release of Daily Gift: a relationship-aware gift engine for OpenClaw.
- Supports five gift formats: H5, image, video, text, and interactive text-play, plus hybrid mode.
- Features setup flow, recurring daily gift delivery (via cron), and on-demand manual gifts, each with its own workflow.
- Prioritizes editorial and emotional judgment over format selection, adapting gifts to relationship context and user history.
- Optimizes asset management with smart, on-demand reference asset fetching for best output quality.
- Includes robust state management and flexible runtime configuration for seamless, personalized gifting experiences.
